mcqs.question: A projectile is launched with speed u at an angle θ above the horizontal. A common mistake is to take the horizontal component as u sinθ. Which of the following correctly gives the horizontal component of the initial velocity?
mcqs.explanation: The horizontal component of the initial velocity is obtained by multiplying the speed by the cosine of the launch angle: u cosθ. Using sinθ gives the vertical component, which is a typical misconception. Options B, C, and D are incorrect for the horizontal component.

mcqs.question: Which of the following equations correctly represents the trajectory y(x) of a projectile launched from the origin with speed u at angle θ, neglecting air resistance?

options.A: y = x tanθ - (g x²)/(2 u² cos²θ)
options.B: y = x tanθ + (g x²)/(2 u² sin²θ)
options.D: y = x cotθ - (g x²)/(2 u² sin²θ)

mcqs.answer: y = x tanθ - (g x²)/(2 u² cos²θ)
mcqs.explanation: Starting from the horizontal motion x = u cosθ t and vertical motion y = u sinθ t - ½gt², eliminating t gives y = x tanθ - (g x²)/(2 u² cos²θ). This is the standard trajectory equation. The other options either have wrong signs or incorrect trigonometric functions.

mcqs.question: Two projectiles are launched from the same level with the same speed u. Projectile A is launched at 30° above the horizontal, Projectile B at 60°. Ignoring air resistance, which statement about their times of flight is correct?

options.A: Both have the same time of flight
options.B: Projectile A stays longer in the air
options.C: Projectile B stays longer in the air
options.D: Time of flight depends only on speed, not on angle

mcqs.answer: Projectile B stays longer in the air
mcqs.explanation: Time of flight T = (2u sinθ)/g. Since sin60° > sin30°, Projectile B (60°) has a larger vertical component and therefore a longer flight time. Option A is false because angle matters; B is opposite; D ignores the angle dependence.

mcqs.question: A stone is projected with speed 20 m/s at 45° above the horizontal from ground level. What is the maximum height reached?
mcqs.explanation: Maximum height H = (u² sin²θ)/(2g). Here u² = 400, sin45° = √2/2, so sin²θ = 0.5. Thus H = (400 × 0.5)/(2 × 9.8) = 200/19.6 ≈ 10.2 m. Options A, C, D result from incorrect use of the formula or arithmetic errors.

mcqs.question: The horizontal range R of a projectile launched from level ground with speed u at angle θ (neglecting air resistance) is given by which expression?
mcqs.explanation: Range R = (horizontal speed) × time of flight = u cosθ × (2u sinθ/g) = (u² sin2θ)/g. Options B, C, D misuse trigonometric functions or omit factors.

mcqs.question: At the highest point of its trajectory, the velocity of a projectile is
mcqs.explanation: At the peak, the vertical component of velocity becomes zero while the horizontal component remains unchanged, so the velocity is purely horizontal. Option A would be true only for a body momentarily at rest, which is not the case; B and D are incorrect.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly distinguishes projectile motion from simple vertical motion?

options.A: Projectile motion has both horizontal and vertical components of motion, while vertical motion has only vertical displacement.
options.B: In projectile motion, acceleration is zero; in vertical motion, acceleration is g.
options.C: Projectile motion occurs only in a vacuum; vertical motion occurs in air.
options.D: The time of flight in projectile motion is always twice that of vertical motion for the same initial speed.

mcqs.answer: Projectile motion has both horizontal and vertical components of motion, while vertical motion has only vertical displacement.
mcqs.explanation: Projectile motion combines uniform horizontal motion with uniformly accelerated vertical motion, whereas pure vertical motion involves only the vertical direction. Options B, C, and D contain false statements about acceleration, medium, and time of flight.

mcqs.question: A ball is thrown with speed 30 m/s at an angle of 37° above the horizontal. What is the horizontal component of its initial velocity (to two decimal places)?
mcqs.explanation: Horizontal component = u cosθ = 30 × cos37°. cos37° ≈ 0.7986, so the component ≈ 30 × 0.7986 ≈ 23.96 m/s, which rounds to 24.0 m/s. Options A, C, D are results of using sinθ, neglecting the cosine, or arithmetic errors.
